notes: Prior Home-Decor pass (archive c187) found the whole domain behind a Cloudflare Managed Challenge via every HTTP-layer route tried (direct fetch, 18 curl_cffi profiles, jina, translate.goog, WebFetch, direct Algolia REST). A real Chrome tab cleared the challenge instantly on the first navigation (robots.txt then /ae/en/) with no retry needed - the challenge is not Claude-specific: robots.txt has no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/Claude-User entry and carries 'Allow: /'. Site is a Next.js SPA (Landmark Group platform, same family as Home Centre SR15/SR243) backed by Algolia; window.__NEXT_REDUX_STORE__.getState().algoliaProductReducer.data.nbHits gave the exact product count for every category page, and was verified to equal the rendered listing header exactly (checked directly: hbxbedroom department page showed nbHits=3367 and rendered text '3367 Products' - byte-for-byte match). The same state's facets['categoryFacetValue.en'] gives every direct child node + its own exact count in one read, which is how the tree below was built and cross-checked (walked every hbx<department> root - Living, Bedroom, Dining, Kitchen, Bathroom, Kids&Youth, Outdoor, Decor&Furnishings - plus the sitemap category XML (530 URLs) grepped for furniture keywords to catch cross-cutting nodes the room-department facets missed). CATEGORY TREE: Living Room (Sofas & Armchairs / Tables & Stands / Media Units & Storage, plus a standalone Shoe Racks leaf), Bedroom (Beds & Bed Sets / Wardrobes / Dressers & Chests / Night Stands / Modular), Dining Room (Dining Tables & Sets / Dining Chairs & Benches / Buffets & Sideboards / Bar Counters & Bar Stools), a standalone Office Furniture node (Desks/Chairs/Book Cases, reached only via the sitemap - not in any department's own facet list), a standalone Outdoor Furniture node (Dining Sets/Swings & Chairs/Sofa Sets/Tables), and Kids & Youth department under category 'Kids Furniture' to avoid name collisions with the main tree (Beds & Bed Sets / Wardrobes / Dressers & Chests / Night Stands / Book Cases / Chairs / Desks / a 1-item Tables & Chairs leaf). EXCLUDED: Mattresses (bedding per brief) at every department; all Bedding/Curtains/Rugs/Wall Decor/Lighting/Home Fragrance/Table Top/Tableware/Kitchenware/Cookware nodes; Bathroom department has zero furniture (Bath Accessories/Bathroom Storage/Bathroom Textiles/Curtains & Rods/Laundry - Bathroom Storage's children Organisers/Laundry Hampers/Jewellery Boxes/Towel Holders are all standalone storage goods, no vanity units exist on this site); Kitchen department has zero furniture (all kitchenware/cookware/storage organisers); Decor & Furnishings department has zero furniture; Kids & Youth > Storage (34, garment racks/coat hangers/storage boxes - standalone storage, not furniture) and > Play Room (7, mostly foam playmats and a notebook, only 1 of 7 items is furniture - excluded as not-primarily-furniture, that 1 item is separately captured as the 1-item 'Tables & Chairs' leaf which has its own distinct canonical URL); hbxbathroom > bath stools (site's own 'Bath Stools' node - non-slip bath stool, toilet stool, step stool - bathroom fixtures/functional aids, not living-space seating furniture, excluded). SANITY CHECKS: (a) every leaf URL's h1/title matched the requested node; (b) two independent counts (department-facet count vs a direct navigation to the leaf's own page) were taken for most nodes and the direct-navigation number was used when they drifted slightly (e.g. Wardrobes dept-facet 95 vs direct-nav 93, Kids Chairs dept-facet 42 vs direct-nav 31 'Kids Chairs' - the site's own dept sidebar count is evidently a cached/looser aggregate, direct nav is closer to the true page render); (c) CROSS-DEPARTMENT DEDUPE TRAP found and fixed: Bedroom's department facet listed 'Shoe Cabinets & Racks' (50) and 'TV & Media Units' (20) as if they were bedroom-specific nodes, but navigating to their own URLs redirected to the exact same canonical pages already captured under Living Room (hbxfurniture-livingroom-shoeracks, nbHits 49; hbxfurniture-livingroom-tvandmediaunits, nbHits 165 = the TV Units 152 + Wall Units 14 children already recorded) - both were dropped from Bedroom to avoid double-counting the same products under two rows; (d) the sitemap sweep surfaced two real leaves invisible in any department's own facet list: 'Lounge Chairs' (hbxfurniture-livingroom-accentchairs, 24, distinct from the already-captured Armchairs/Easy Chairs) and 'Tea Table Sets' (hbxfurniture-livingroom-teatablesets, 21, distinct from Dining's own 1-item Tea Table Sets under Dining Tables & Sets) - both added under Living Room; the sweep also confirmed dozens of size/seat-count/brand-collection filter suffixes (e.g. -king, -fourseater, -hampton) are not real categories and were excluded per the brief. Never used probe.py/curl/requests/WebFetch to reach the target - Chrome connector only throughout.
